serverInfo.name: robots-policy-lint
serverInfo.title: Robots Policy Lint
serverInfo.description: Lint your robots.txt and see which AI crawlers it really blocks. Free, no key, nothing to install. Evaluates paths against RFC 9309 and diffs two policies. Call no_arguments_lint_this_hosts_robots_txt, it takes no arguments: it returns the full lint of THIS host's own robots.txt and ai.txt — every finding with its line and fix, and a verdict per crawler per path naming the rule that decided it. am_i_allowed, whoami and example are the other three zero-argument calls.
